ns2:course.label: Migration and French National Identity
ns2:course.description: Studies books and films that introduce students to historical and contemporary debates surrounding French national identity in migrant and immigrant contexts in France. Emphasizes cultural difference and the complexities of the post-colonial world. Emphasizes themes of collective identity and community formation, immigration and exile, tensions between relations of domination and exploitation and between colonizing and colonized peoples, and the cultural pluralities of community and nation.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Humanities - Lit & Arts, and Cultural Studies - Western course.
